actions.description: Inspect failover dir and listening ports
actions.command: ls -la /var/lib/failover/ 2>&1; echo "---"; cat /var/lib/failover/* 2>/dev/null | head -50; echo "=== listening ==="; (ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null || netstat -ltnp 2>/dev/null) | grep -E '8080|8081|8082'

ps aux | grep -iE 'proxy|replica|primary|failover|node|python|808' | grep -v grep; echo "=== systemd ==="; systemctl list-units --type=service 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'fail|proxy|replica|primary' ; echo "=== files ==="; ls -la /root /opt /srv /etc/systemd/system 2>/dev/null | head -80
ls -la /var/lib/failover/; echo "=== contents ==="; for f in /var/lib/failover/*; do echo "--- $f ---"; file "$f"; head -c 300 "$f" | cat -v; echo; done
